clue.text: Thoroughly cook bitter dessert

parts.note: to bake well is to cook something thoroughly
tart means sharp or bitter in taste

explanation.surface: A cooking instruction for a sharp-tasting pudding.
explanation.walkthrough: A Bakewell tart is a British almond-and-jam pastry named after a town in Derbyshire.
explanation.definitionFit: This tart is a traditional English sweet course, so it is an example of a pudding.

clue.text: Marsupial in group with one bird

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a coot is a water bird

explanation.surface: A pouched animal travelling in a pack alongside a single bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The bandicoot is a small Australian pouched mammal, so it is an example of that animal class.

clue.text: Card cheat?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the jack in a pack of playing cards

explanation.walkthrough: Read together it suggests a card sharp; the two words are separate meanings of one word.
explanation.definitionFit: The jack in a deck is also called by this name, and the word also means a dishonest scoundrel.

clue.text: Least good way to support argument that's come up

indicators.note: in a down entry, a supporting part sits underneath the other part
in a down entry, something that has come up reads from the bottom to the top

parts.note: ST, short for street, is a way

explanation.surface: Talk of the weakest way to back up a point that has been raised in debate.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of bad describes whatever is lowest in quality.

clue.text: Unreal ray spinning for some time on the moon

indicators.note: spinning things are whirled about, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Science fiction: a fantastical spinning beam fired for a while on the moon.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: it is a period reckoned by the moon's cycles rather than time spent there.
explanation.definitionFit: A calendar of twelve monthly cycles of the moon makes a period of roughly 354 days.

clue.text: Old reptile's tail found in the American reference book

indicators.note: one part is found inside the other, which wraps around it
only the rear end of the creature is wanted, so its front part is dropped

parts.note: a dinosaur is an extinct reptile

explanation.surface: A fossil-hunter's report of a dinosaur's tail turning up in America.
explanation.walkthrough: The tail here is the back half of the creature's name, not just its final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: This book lists words grouped by similar meaning, so it is a kind of work consulted for language.

clue.text: Emperor up above a worshipper of Haile Selassie

indicators.note: in a down entry, the part above comes first
in a down entry, going up means reading from the bottom to the top

parts.note: a tsar was a Russian emperor

explanation.surface: An emperor placed high above one of his own devotees.
explanation.walkthrough: Haile Selassie was himself an emperor, of Ethiopia, which gives the surface its neatness.
explanation.definitionFit: A Rastafarian, shortened, follows the movement that venerates the Ethiopian ruler as divine.

clue.text: Boy, a Greek town needs a US city

parts.note: Delphi is the Greek town of the ancient oracle

explanation.surface: A young man and a Greek town said to require an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pennsylvania metropolis is a major American city.

clue.text: Somewhat ashen, natural dye

indicators.note: somewhat means only part of something, so a run of letters is taken from inside the words

parts.note: the letters run across the two words

explanation.surface: A greyish-coloured dye made from plants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Natural' reads as part of the definition, but its first letters finish the run hidden across the two words.
explanation.definitionFit: This reddish colouring comes from a plant's leaves and is used on hair and skin.

clue.text: Silver medallists, athletes on the climb?

explanation.surface: Second-placed competitors pictured as athletes running uphill.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who finish second take silver, so they are the ones placed just behind the winner.

clue.text: Harry's turn to get ceramicist's machine

parts.note: Harry Potter is the boy wizard of the books

explanation.surface: The boy wizard's go at operating a pottery machine.
explanation.definitionFit: A spinning disc on which clay is shaped is the potter's central tool.

clue.text: I select new queen for English city

indicators.note: something new is made afresh, so the letters are put in a fresh order

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the crossword queen

explanation.surface: Someone choosing a new monarch for an English city.
explanation.definitionFit: The Midlands city of that name is a major English urban centre.

clue.text: A section cut off

explanation.surface: A piece that has been severed from the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Something isolated or separated from others stands away from them.

clue.text: Cake hits the floor before ice cream

indicators.note: coming before means the first part is placed ahead of the second

parts.note: something that drops falls to the floor
an ice cream in a wafer is a cone

explanation.surface: A dessert disaster: the cake falls to the floor before the ice cream does.
explanation.walkthrough: A drop scone is a small thick pancake, also called a Scotch pancake in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: This small griddle pancake counts loosely as a teatime baked treat.

clue.text: Star that explodes, vapour sent endlessly flying

indicators.note: things sent flying are scattered, so the letters land in a new order
without its end, the word loses its final letter

parts.note: taken as written, then cut short

explanation.surface: An exploding star scattering gas endlessly through space.
explanation.definitionFit: A supernova is the brilliant, catastrophic burst of a dying massive star.

clue.text: Where chairman presides in the main, unfortunately?

definitions.note: read as two words: over the board of directors
definitions.meaning: first meaning, split into two words: a chairman presides over the board of directors
second meaning: the main is the sea, where someone lands after falling from a ship

explanation.walkthrough: The first meaning only works split in two; the main is an old word for the open sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes someone or something gone over the side of a vessel into the water.

clue.text: Line raised, structure spanning river perhaps not opening

indicators.note: with no opening, the word loses its first letter

parts.note: a bridge spans a river, among other things

explanation.surface: An engineer's description of a raised line on a bridge over a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A long narrow elevated strip of land, or a raised crest, forms such a line.

clue.text: Writer admits art is dubious

indicators.note: something dubious is unreliable, so the letters are not in their proper order

explanation.surface: An author confesses that their art is questionable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Admits' looks like a container signal, but it is part of the letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A playwright is someone who writes for the stage.

clue.text: Tulip roughly like a bulb, perhaps?

indicators.note: roughly means approximately, so the letters are only loosely in order

explanation.surface: A tulip is rather like a bulb, since it grows from one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bulb' leads to gardening, but the definition means a light bulb, which is lit when switched on.
explanation.definitionFit: A light bulb glows when switched on, so it is illuminated.

clue.text: Turks for example are in US, as travelling

indicators.note: travelling letters move about, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Turkish people are in America while touring.
explanation.definitionFit: Turkey straddles Europe and Asia, so its people can be called people of both continents.

clue.text: Poet, messenger of war?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the ancient Greek poet of the Iliad
second meaning: a homing pigeon, used to carry messages in wartime

explanation.walkthrough: The Iliad is a war poem, so the surface makes the poet a messenger of war; the second meaning is a pigeon.
explanation.definitionFit: The epic poet shares his name with a pigeon trained to fly home, once used for wartime dispatches.

clue.text: Mother put on party — there's wine!

indicators.note: in a down entry, placed on means the first part is on top of the second

parts.note: CON is short for the Conservative party

explanation.surface: Mum throws a party, and there is wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Mâcon is a Burgundy wine named after its French town.

clue.text: Mark supports strike

explanation.surface: A man named Mark backs a workers' strike.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mark' looks like a man's name, but it is a typed symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: The backward-leaning slash is a printed symbol on keyboards.

clue.text: The mating game?

parts.note: setter's reading: mate, as in checkmate, ends a board game

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase suggests romance, but the game is the one won by checkmate.
explanation.definitionFit: This board game is won by trapping the opposing king, which is called mate.

clue.text: Crack swimmer claiming victory

indicators.note: claiming something means taking hold of it, so one part holds another

explanation.surface: An expert swimmer claims a win.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swimmer' suggests a person, but it is a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To crack a puzzle or code is to work it out.

clue.text: An unenjoyable job bagging silver in US port

indicators.note: bagging means putting into a bag, so one part holds another

parts.note: a chore is a tedious task
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A dull task of loading silver in an American harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: The Alaskan city of that name is a seaport in the United States.

clue.text: French river I will have knowledge about

indicators.note: about means around, so one part goes around the other

explanation.surface: Someone boasting they know all about a French river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Loire is the longest river in France.

clue.text: Brilliant journey down from Machu Picchu, say?

parts.note: Machu Picchu is an Inca citadel in Peru
a descent is a journey downwards

explanation.surface: A splendid hike down from the Peruvian ruins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brilliant' looks like praise for the trip, but it means glowing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something glowing with intense heat and light shines very brightly.
